name: How long does it take to remove kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: For an average residential kitchen, removing cabinets typically takes between four to eight hours. The exact timeline depends on the kitchen size, whether countertops and backsplashes must come off first, and whether the cabinets are being salvaged. Glued-on elements, heavy custom trim, and complicated island utility lines can add time. In contrast, standard modular boxes fastened strictly with drywall screws come down much faster, usually wrapping up in less than half a day.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most kitchen cabinet tear-outs take four to eight hours, depending on kitchen size, countertop materials, and whether the units are being salvaged.
